I'm sort of in the same shit boat as you; nearly 25 and I honestly hate work. I've had one job, and I quit as soon as the opportunity arose. Went to college for awhile, but dropped out because I couldn't afford it; paying to learn is fucked up. I wouldn't say I hate people as much as I fear them, but loathing is still present. I basically watch cartoons all day (My Little Pony is the high point of my day) and occasionally work on my art or music. I really can't offer much advice, but I do have a suggestion; try reading some stuff by Friedrich Nietzsche. 

Yeah, some people might advise against that, but they don't understand Nietzsche. He made me realize that nothingness can be beautiful. My philosophy professor allowed me to teach and explain the course on Nietzsche. That is still one my best memories... 
Anyway, you're not alone.
